title: iPhone 18 and 18e Coming in Spring 2027 With A20 Chip

content_html:
Apple's iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will launch in spring 2027 with an A20 chip, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reiterated on the latest episode of his "Power On" podcast. The remarks align with his previous reporting on the launch timing. The iPhone Air 2 is also expected at the same time.

Popular Stories

Apple Now Inviting Media to October 28 'Launch Experience'

Apple has begun inviting selected members of the media to a product launch experience in Los Angeles on Wednesday, October 28, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. In a post on X, Gurman described the gathering as an "all-day product launch experience" for touchscreen MacBooks, a new iPad mini, and Macs equipped with M6 chips. iPhone Duo 2 Prototypes Include Under-Display Face ID

Apple's second-generation iPhone Duo could gain Face ID, with prototypes already incorporating the technology beneath the outer display, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. In the latest episode of his "Power On" podcast, Gurman described Apple's work on adding facial authentication technology to its foldable iPhone. iPhone 18e Could Get Two Key Upgrades While Keeping 60Hz Display

Apple's upcoming iPhone 18e model will retain a 60Hz display but could gain an upgraded front-facing camera, according to the leaker known as "Digital Chat Station." In a new post on Weibo, the leaker said that the device will feature a 6.12-inch OLED display using low-temperature polycrystalline silicon (LTPS) technology, the A20 chip, and a single 48-megapixel rear camera.
